name: codex-smart-worker
description: Automatically route worthwhile bounded subtasks throughout Codex work through TypeSafe Jev to DeepSeek Flash for Codex review.

interface.shortDescription: Automatically delegate suitable subtasks throughout work.
interface.longDescription: Without an explicit plugin mention, Codex identifies worthwhile independent subtasks throughout each request. TypeSafe Jev routes sanitized candidates to DeepSeek Flash when risk and confidence allow. Codex plans, uses tools, reviews proposals and reports aggregate request usage.
interface.defaultPrompt: Automatically delegate suitable bounded subtasks throughout this request, review each proposal, and report aggregate Smart Worker usage.
